description:
Does Mother's Day have pagan roots? Should we as Christians celebrate it? We want to honor our Mothers. Daniel Perrin shines some light into this question along with Daniel Morikone, and Pastor James Rafferty. Hosted by Idalia Dinzey, we are sure to be enlightened.


Send us your Bible Questions! 
By email: BibleQA@3abn.org 
By text: (618) 228-3975

QUESTIONS COVERED:


1. Can you please explain 1 Peter 3:18-19? What spirits did Jesus preach to? I don’t understand it. 

2. Is once saved always saved biblical? 

3. Can you please explain John 8:17-18? Two witnesses are not always true. Naboth had two witnesses. 

4. How can we explain Hebrews 9:12 in regards to 1844 and the Heavenly Sanctuary? It mentions that Christ has already entered the Most Holy Place. 

5. Jacob (Israel) had 12 sons, thus making the 12 Tribes of Israel. (1) Reuben, (2) Simeon, (3) Levi, (4) Judah, (5) Dan, (6) Naphtali, (7) Gad, (8) Asher, (9) Issachar, (10) Zebulun, 11) Joseph, (12) Benjamin. But the 12 tribes (the 144,000) in Revelation 7:4-8 are Judah, Reuben, Gad, Asher, Naphtali, Manasseh, Simeon, Levi, Issachar, Zebulun, Joseph, and Benjamin. Why is Dan omitted and Manasseh added and why Manaaseh and not Ephraim? Can you please explain the 12 Tribes of Israel?

6. Should Christians celebrate Mother's Day since it has pagan roots? 

7. Revelation 1:7 says, "Behold He is coming with clouds and every eye shall see Him even those who pierced Him."  Will everyone see Jesus at the same time upon His return?

8. I want to become a better student of the Word, are there any tools/aids you could suggest, such as concordances, that would be of help to me in achieving this? What tools can I use to assist me in studying the Bible? 

9. What can we do to make worshiping the Lord a pleasure? 

10. Since nearly all Bible prophesy, especially the great metal image, is largely related to events in the Middle East, is it reasonable to assume the first and greatest end-time events will also focus more intently on Middle East conditions - more, and faster than the other world continents and societies?  Will the end-time events begin in the Middle East?

11.  What does Matthew 24:20 mean? Why did Jesus tell them to pray that their flight might not be in winter or on the Sabbath day?

12. My dog was just diagnosed with Leukemia. Is it a sin to euthanize him? Is there anything In the Bible that says anything about this? Is it a sin to euthanize our pets?
